summary: Zero-TOTP is a web-based application designed for storing and managing time-based one-time password codes. It relies on zero-knowledge encryption to ensure that authentication secrets remain private on the server.
goodFor: It suits individuals looking for a self-hosted alternative to commercial authenticator apps while keeping their multi-factor authentication seeds under their own control.
watchOut: With a small community and limited adoption metrics, you may encounter edge cases or a lack of documentation compared to mainstream password managers.
deployNotes: Since it runs via Docker, you will typically need to configure persistent storage for your encrypted data volumes and place the container behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
